input.quote: 12.3 Nothing restricts Customer from developing, acquiring, licensing, selling, or using any product or service, engaging any supplier, hiring any person who responds to general recruitment, or conducting business in any field or territory. Vendor acknowledges that Customer has made no exclusivity, non-compete, most-favoured-customer, minimum-volume, or no-hire commitment.
input.rationale: The agreement contains no non-compete or field-of-use restriction on us. Clause 12.3 goes further and expressly confirms that nothing restricts Customer from developing, acquiring, licensing, selling or using any product or service, engaging any supplier, or conducting business in any field or territory, and that no exclusivity, non-compete, MFC, minimum-volume or no-hire commitment has been made. The only competition restriction (12.4) binds Vendor and benefits us, so it is not flagged. The sole Customer-side prohibition elsewhere (13.4, reverse engineering of hosted source code, subject to the statutory carve-out) is a standard IP protection, not a field-of-use or non-compete restriction. This meets the preferred position.
